LegacyBase.module-surface: src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue: defer muya engine init for non-active (background) tabs via requestIdleCallback. Active visible tab: sync init (current behavior). Background tab: placeholder rendered first, muya inits on idle ≤2s timeout. Switch to deferred tab triggers immediate init. Per-tab state machine: pending → initializing → ready → (closed) destroyed | error. Polyfill via setTimeout(50) at src/renderer/src/util/idle.ts (single chokepoint).

high-level-scenarios.S4: Tab close before idle slot — clearTimeout/cancelIdleCallback; no orphan muya allocation; bounded memory.

failure-scenarios.F3: Tab closed during in-flight initializing — disposal flag; on muya ready, `if(disposed) muya.destroy(); return`; bounded memory.
failure-scenarios.F5: Placeholder render itself throws — error boundary fallback; tab marked error; user can close.
failure-scenarios.F6: muya ready never fires — 2s deferred-init watchdog escalates: warn, mark error, surface in placeholder.

race-conditions.R1: Rapid Cmd+Tab through 4 deferred — each switch promotes synchronously; previously promoted continue background; no double-init via per-tab `state !== pending` guard.
race-conditions.R2: Tab close during idle queue processing — current init completes; closed tab cancelled cleanly; queue advances.
race-conditions.R3: 10-tab session + immediate Cmd+9 — tab 9 promoted synchronously, queue continues serial 1-8 behind; no skipped, no re-init.
race-conditions.R4: Two near-simultaneous switches (16ms double-tap) — first promotes (state=initializing); second sees `state !== pending` → no-op.
race-conditions.R5: Idle callback fires concurrent with user switch — compare-and-swap on per-tab state; one wins, other no-op.
race-conditions.R6: Window-close during placeholder render of newly opened — placeholder render aborts via component teardown; idle never registered or cancelled.

high-level-scenarios.S1: First launch with no state file — defaults from tauri.conf.json; state file created on quit.
high-level-scenarios.S2: Second launch restore — width/height/x/y exact restore; no flash of default 1024x768; position drift = 0px.
high-level-scenarios.S3: Maximized restore — green traffic light zoom preserved; no transient unmaximized frame.
high-level-scenarios.S4: Fullscreen restore — Cmd+Ctrl+F state preserved with display memory; no flicker through windowed.
high-level-scenarios.S5: Multi-display restore — saved on display 2; both still connected; restore on display 2.
high-level-scenarios.S6: Multi-window main-only — settings window NOT tracked (intentional scope); state file labels=1.

failure-scenarios.F1: Corrupt state file (invalid JSON) — fall back to tauri.conf.json defaults; heal on next clean quit.
failure-scenarios.F2: Partial write from kill -9 mid-debounce — same fallback; verify atomic-rename pattern (write .tmp + rename(2)).
failure-scenarios.F3: Saved display disconnected — re-center on primary; preserve dimensions if fit, else clamp.
failure-scenarios.F4: Off-screen coords (resolution downscaled) — clamp position to display bounds; all 4 corners on-screen.
failure-scenarios.F5: App Support dir not writable (chmod 000) — defaults; logged IO error; quit-write fails gracefully.
failure-scenarios.F6: Schema mismatch from older plugin version — tolerate unknown keys; defaults for missing; rewrite on quit.

race-conditions.R1: Rapid quit-relaunch lock contention — atomic rename ensures readable file; second instance reads previous-prior valid state worst case.
race-conditions.R2: Settings window opened during main-window drag — labels independent; main's debounce flush + quit not affected.
race-conditions.R3: Debounce vs quit — pending debounced write flushed synchronously before window destroy.
race-conditions.R4: Display change mid-run (USB-C unplug) — macOS handles window jump; plugin records new geometry on quit.

numeric-thresholds.T2: State write debounce ≤500ms (resize → write); ≥50ms (avoid pixel-rate writes); ≤10 writes per 5s drag.
numeric-thresholds.T3: State file size ≤2KB per window-label entry.
numeric-thresholds.T6: Visual snap frames = 0 (no intermediate paint at defaults).
numeric-thresholds.T7: Pre-mount restore order: BLOCK_STATE_PARSED < renderer mount.
numeric-thresholds.T8: State file write atomicity: rename(2) on .tmp → final via fs_usage trace.

LegacyBase.module-surface: Three-part module: PART A (instrumentation): BOOT_T0 = `Lazy<Instant>` referenced as LITERAL first stmt of main() in src-tauri/src/m001_main.rs (`let _ = *boot_marker::BOOT_T0;`) BEFORE panic hook install. `boot_marker!()` Rust proc-macro/fn at src-tauri/src/boot_marker.rs auto-interpolates `elapsed_ms=N`. JS BOOT_T0 captured as inline `<script>` in <head> BEFORE module scripts: `window.__BOOT_T0__ = performance.now()`. JS helper at src/renderer/src/boot-marker.js exports `bootMark(label)` reading window.__BOOT_T0__ (never reassigns). PART B (harness): tools/bench-launch.mjs CLI launches Mark via `time mark /tmp/test.md`, captures stderr+stdout, parses BLOCK_* markers, builds waterfall report. PART C (CI gate): `--ci` mode reads tools/bench-baseline.json, fails if any waterfall stage regresses >10%. tools/bench-config.json tunable thresholds. .github/workflows/perf-gate.yml on macos-14.

high-level-scenarios.S1: Bench-launch cold cache single-file — `node tools/bench-launch.mjs --runs 3 --cold /tmp/test.md`; 3 launches, median of last 2, all 9 phases present, total ≤1500ms M2.
high-level-scenarios.S2: Bench-launch warm cache repeat — `--warm`; median 30-50% faster; same phase set; cache_state="warm" in report header.
high-level-scenarios.S3: CI regression gate — no regression — `--ci`; all ratios ≤1.10; exit 0; PASS summary.
high-level-scenarios.S4: Baseline regen — `npm run bench:update-baseline` (= `--update-baseline --runs 5`); writes median + p95, git SHA, chip, Tauri/Vue version; backup to .prev.json.

high-level-scenarios.S6: Per-stage threshold override — bench-config.json overrides vue-mount to 1.05; other stages keep 1.10 default.

failure-scenarios.F1: Mark binary missing — fail fast BEFORE first launch; BLOCK_FATAL reason=binary_not_found; exit 10.
failure-scenarios.F2: BLOCK_* markers missing (instrumentation regression) — BLOCK_INSTRUMENTATION_REGRESSION expected_phases=9 found=8 missing=[panic]; exit 11.
failure-scenarios.F3: Parser fails on malformed marker (elapsed_ms=NaN) — quarantine bad lines; abort if >5% threshold; BLOCK_PARSE_ERROR; exit 12.
failure-scenarios.F4: CI regression detected — vue-mount 80→280ms; ratio 3.50; BLOCK_REGRESSION per run + summary; exit 1.
failure-scenarios.F5: Mark hangs at vue-mount — per-launch wall-clock timeout 30s; BLOCK_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT last_phase_seen; partial waterfall; exit 13.
failure-scenarios.F6: Baseline JSON corrupt or schema-incompatible — fail before launching; BLOCK_FATAL reason=baseline_invalid; exit 14.
failure-scenarios.F7: `time` output unparseable — Node hrtime() fallback; warning only; exit 0.

race-conditions.R1: Concurrent bench runs — proper-lockfile on tools/.bench.lock; second errors with BLOCK_FATAL holder_pid; exit 15.
race-conditions.R2: System load spike (CI runner contention) — median-of-last-2-runs (run 1 priming); MAD-trimmed median if spread >25%; up to 3 retries; BLOCK_INSTABILITY; CI yellow not red.
race-conditions.R3: Launch-services cache state varies — explicit mode (`--cold` purges via lsregister, `--warm` primes); baseline records cache_state; CI compares like-to-like.
race-conditions.R4: BOOT_T0 capture race (Rust) — eager Lazy deref as LITERAL first stmt before panic hook; rustc --emit=mir inspection; cargo test test_boot_t0_eager.
race-conditions.R5: BOOT_T0 capture race (JS) — inline script in <head> BEFORE any <script type="module">; helper reads, never reassigns.
race-conditions.R6: stderr/stdout interleaving — parser tags each line with capture timestamp; sorts by elapsed_ms field, NOT capture order.

numeric-thresholds.T1: Every BLOCK_* marker carries elapsed_ms=N (100% coverage; 0 missing); CI lint tools/bench-lint-markers.mjs.
numeric-thresholds.T5: Per-stage regression threshold 1.10 default; cumulative end-to-end 1.15.
numeric-thresholds.T6: Median spread tolerance ≤25% between last 2 runs; retry up to 3×.
numeric-thresholds.T7: Phase budgets M2: panic ≤5ms, window ≤50ms, renderer-load ≤200ms, splash ≤30ms, vue-mount ≤150ms, ipc-listeners ≤30ms, bootstrap-editor ≤250ms, first-paint ≤600ms cumulative SLA, first-tab-loaded ≤900ms cumulative SLA.
numeric-thresholds.T8: Baseline freshness: regenerate quarterly OR on Tauri/Vue major; warn if >90 days.
